<thought>The initial template search with only “ketones” broken and “ether oxygens” formed returned no results. The reaction description also mentions that an aromatic hydroxyl is broken and a C‑C bond is formed in addition to the C‑O bond formation. I will broaden the search to include both broken functional groups (“ketones” and “aromatic hydroxyls”) and the formed ether oxygen, without restricting bonds. This should retrieve the appropriate retrosynthetic template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
